question: Which party controls the US House after the 2026 elections
quote: Hakeem Jeffries will be Speaker of the House.
turn_text: I have them at 12, 227 Democrats. I know it doesn't sound like a lot, but particularly when the Senate races are breaking so rough for them. But there's just a ceiling. There just aren't that many competitive races the way there used to be. The redistricting helped Republicans somewhat. It was not the huge, you know. So ironically, I think it's going to be less dramatic of an impact than people expected. You know, Hakeem Jeffries will be Speaker of the House. It's going to be really annoying. He's going to have to do a lot to placate the DSA caucus. But hey, you know, as the Democrats will say, now they're catching grenades instead of throwing them.
host_quote: How many House pickups for the Democrats Tuesday night?
ask_turn_text: Yeah, exactly. So the scenarios that Jim and I have put a lot of pressure on Fetterman. And so Jim Gary, exit question on this round for you. Go to you first. How many House pickups for the Democrats Tuesday night?
resolution_criteria: The party that wins a majority of US House seats in the 2026 general election. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when control is called.
